'''Gibbs''' was a [[Changeling/Legends|shape-shifter]] who had been hired to aid in the assassination of [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Lavina Durada-Vashne Wren]] of [[Cularin/Legends|Cularin]]. Posing as a [[Human/Legends|Human]], he infiltrated the ranks of Cularin's government during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] and was put in charge of arranging the events which heralded the return of Senator Wren from the [[Coruscant/Legends|Galactic capital]]. While trying to throw [[Warlan Presvere Tosk]] off his trail, it would later be revealed that Gibbs was working with an [[Assassin/Legends|assassin]] who had been hired to kill Senator Wren.
